high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "movingtalkies." The post features a black-and-white photograph of two individuals, a man and a woman, standing close together against a textured brick wall. The woman has her arm around the man's shoulder, and both appear to be smiling warmly at the camera. The text on the post reads: "Childhood is when we feel sad for Nazriya choosing Fahad Maturity is when we realise Nazriya is nowhere near of Fahadh's league" The post has received 15,167 likes and was posted on July 27.
